apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Stop — chest tightness that builds on exertion and eases with rest is a cardiac red flag, not a training variable. I won't program around it, harder or otherwise.

Get this checked by a doctor before your next run. No workout substitute for this one.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

Same answer: exertional chest tightness that eases with rest is a cardiac red flag regardless of how fit you feel otherwise — not something I'll train through or around. I'm not scheduling the intervals.

See a doctor before your next run. That's it from me on this until it's cleared.
